evals.name: single-expert-json-package
evals.prompt: 把临时用户主目录和临时 cwd 设为两个不同目录，不注入 MobileWork 宿主合同，也不传 --output-dir 或 --my-experts，从 references/expert-json-spec.md 的 expert-json 模板块取得模板并生成一个 MobileWork 单专家项目包。
evals.expected_output: A type: expert package generated only under <cwd>/<slug> with expert.json, README.md, runtime config JSON, one primary agent, and local skills; the workspace root configuration is unchanged and nothing is written to the user's my-experts directory.
expectations: Runs check_environment.py, reads hostMode=workspace, and creates the package only under <cwd>/<slug>.
Does not modify root .opencode, opencode.json or mobilework.jsonc and does not write under <home>/.mobilework/my-experts.
Creates expert.json as the only package manifest.
Creates exactly one primary agent and no subagent entries.
Generated single expert Markdown frontmatter includes name, displayName, profession, steps, mode, color, and permission, and does not emit maxTurns.
Generated single expert Markdown includes core capabilities, trigger scenarios, workflow, output format, and quality gates.
Generated single expert Markdown does not include TeamCreate, SendMessage, subagent_type, or task_id delegation rules.
Preserves avatar_url, tags, quick_prompts, default_prompt, profession, and category_id in expert.json and generated prompts.
Creates package-local avatars files for the top-level expert and the single expert agent when local avatar files are missing.
All local avatar_url values in expert.json resolve to files inside the generated package.
Generated single expert Markdown frontmatter avatar_url matches expert.json agent.avatar_url.
Creates common and role-specific skill directories.
Generated expert.json and runtime config JSON validate as JSON.
Does not create package-level AGENTS.md; workspace-wide custom instructions are owned only through declared .opencode/instructions files and opencode.json.instructions.
Creates README.md generated from expert.json using MobileWork Chinese introduction sections.
Single expert README includes 类型, 功能, 专家能力, 工作流程, 内置技能, 使用示例, 包结构, 运行时扩展, and 注意事项.
Generated README.md, common skill, role skill, and agent Markdown use Chinese framework text by default.
README.md does not contain old English skeleton headings such as Generated MobileWork or Public Shape.
Does not create extra root-level config or hidden directories.

evals.name: expert-team-json-package
evals.prompt: 把临时用户主目录和临时 cwd 设为两个不同目录，不注入 MobileWork 宿主合同，也不传 --output-dir 或 --my-experts，将 evals/files/software-dev-team.expert.json 复制为临时 expert.json 后生成一个 MobileWork 专家团项目包。
evals.expected_output: A type: team package generated only under <cwd>/<slug> with one primary agent, multiple subagents, expert.json, README.md, runtime config JSON, local skills, and workflow routing; the workspace root configuration and user my-experts directory remain unchanged.
expectations: Runs check_environment.py, reads hostMode=workspace, and creates the package only under <cwd>/<slug> without changing workspace root configuration.
Creates one primary agent and at least four subagent markdown files.
Primary and subagent Markdown frontmatter plus opencode.json agent entries include the correct steps values and do not emit maxTurns.
Primary agent includes team roster, direct routing table, declared workflows, task collaboration rules, forbidden behaviors, and task.subagent_type examples for declared subagent ids.
Primary agent explains how to retain returned task_id values and resume the same task for failed acceptance checks; every subagent returns through its task result.
Primary agent explains serial versus parallel routing and failed-branch re-dispatch.
Subagent Markdown forbids further delegation and direct user-facing final output, and returns evidence plus acceptance criteria status through its task result.
No generated team Markdown contains TeamCreate or SendMessage, and the package passes the current validator before and after zip extraction.
Creates package-local avatars files for the team, the primary agent, and every subagent when local avatar files are missing.
All local avatar_url values in expert.json resolve to files inside the generated package.
Every generated agent Markdown frontmatter avatar_url matches the corresponding primary_agent or subagents[] avatar_url.
Creates role-specific skills declared in expert.json.
Does not create package-level AGENTS.md; workspace-wide custom instructions are owned only through declared .opencode/instructions files and opencode.json.instructions.
Creates README.md generated from expert.json using MobileWork Chinese introduction sections.
Team README includes 类型, 功能, 团队角色, 工作流程, 内置技能, 使用示例, 包结构, 运行时扩展, and 注意事项.
Generated README.md, common skill, role skill, and agent Markdown use Chinese framework text by default.
README.md does not contain old English skeleton headings such as Generated MobileWork or Public Shape.
Does not create extra root-level config or hidden directories.

evals.name: manifest-required
evals.prompt: 检查一个包：它没有 expert.json，但根目录有不支持的额外配置文件。应该指出当前包结构缺少 expert.json，不要从其他根文件推断配置。
evals.expected_output: A validation failure explaining that expert.json is required and unsupported root config files are not part of the current package structure.
expectations: Rejects packages missing expert.json.
Rejects unsupported root-level config files.
Does not create a partial generated package.

evals.name: invalid-type-shape
evals.prompt: 检查一个 expert.json：type 是 expert 但同时写了 subagents；另一个 type 是 team 但没有 subagents。应该失败。
evals.expected_output: Validation errors for expert/team structural mismatch.
expectations: Rejects type expert with subagents or primary_agent.
Rejects type team without at least one subagent.
Reports the exact invalid structural field.

evals.name: workflow-reference-validation
evals.prompt: 检查一个专家团 expert.json：workflows[].phases[].agents 引用了不存在的 agent id。应该失败。
evals.expected_output: Validation error for workflow phase references to undeclared agent ids.
expectations: Validates workflow phase mode.
Rejects workflow phases that reference unknown agents.
Allows primary-only phases when mode is primary and agents is empty.

evals.name: mcp-placeholder-policy
evals.prompt: 生成一个带远程 MCP 和本地 MCP 的专家团，但所有 MCP 都先占位禁用。
evals.expected_output: A runtime config JSON with local and remote MCP definitions where enabled is false.
expectations: Remote MCP entry includes type remote and a URL placeholder.
Local MCP entry includes type local and command array placeholder.
All generated MCP entries include enabled false unless expert.json explicitly says otherwise.
Validator rejects generated packages if MCP enabled values differ from expert.json.

evals.name: runtime-extensions-full-package
evals.prompt: 从 references/expert-json-spec.md 的 expert-json 模板块创建一个可真实运行的单专家包：expert.json.runtime_extensions 同时声明 commands、带非空源码的 custom_tools、plugins.npm、plugins.local、plugins.package_json、reference_files 及其 local references alias、一个带 branch/description/hidden 的 Git repository reference、instruction_files 及其 instructions glob、LSP；expert.json.mcp_servers 声明一个使用 {env:MOBILEWORK_EVAL_TOKEN} 的远程 MCP。为每个 local 声明提供真实 backing file 和非空内容，生成后校验包、解析 expert.json/opencode.json/.env.example，安装到临时 workspace，再检查所有资源落位、alias、环境变量占位和安装配置投影。
evals.expected_output: A generated, validated, and installed single-expert package where every declared runtime extension has a real package-local backing file, aliases and environment placeholders are exact, and the installed .mobilework-engine projection contains no unresolved placeholders or foreign-host leakage.
expectations: Creates .opencode/commands/<name>.md for each runtime_extensions.commands entry.
Creates non-empty .opencode/tools/*.js or *.ts files from every runtime_extensions.custom_tools entry.

Creates non-empty .opencode/plugins/*.js or *.ts files and .opencode/package.json when plugins.local and plugins.package_json are declared; opencode.json.plugin contains only declared npm package names because local plugins are auto-discovered.

Creates the exact files declared by reference_files under .opencode/references/<slug>/<alias>/ and by instruction_files under .opencode/instructions/<slug>/, and creates no root references/ or instructions/ directories.

Namespaces each generated opencode.json reference alias as <slug>-<alias>; local reference paths resolve to declared package-local backing files, the Git entry preserves repository/branch/description/hidden, instructions contain only declared instruction files, and plugin plus lsp entries are emitted only because they were declared.

Preserves {env:MOBILEWORK_EVAL_TOKEN} in the generated remote MCP configuration, emits enabled exactly as declared, and creates .env.example containing exactly MOBILEWORK_EVAL_TOKEN=<required> with no real secret.

Generated expert.json, opencode.json, command Markdown, tool/plugin source, references, and instructions contain no unresolved [TODO], empty template/source/file bodies, or empty required placeholder values.
Generated package content contains no WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy host leakage such as .codebuddy-plugin, plugin.json, WORKBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR, TeamCreate, or SendMessage.
install_expert.py copies commands, tools, plugins, references, instructions, package.json, and the MCP configuration into the workspace .mobilework-engine projection.

install_expert.py merges agent, mcp, plugin, references, instructions, and lsp into .mobilework-engine/mobilework-engine.jsonc; reference aliases remain <slug>-<alias>, reference paths rebase under references/<slug>/<alias>, and instruction globs rebase under .mobilework-engine/instructions/<slug>.
install_expert.py writes .mobilework-engine/.expert-installs/<slug>.json, every receipt-owned path exists, and the installed config is accepted by opencode debug config --pure.

evals.name: runtime-extensions-portability-rejections
evals.prompt: 检查 runtime_extensions 负例：custom_tools 或 plugins 使用绝对路径或 ..；reference 使用字符串简写、同时或都不声明 path/repository、local 带 branch、未知字段、错误 hidden 类型、单文件路径、没有 backing file 或存在无人拥有的 reference_files；instruction 使用 HTTP 或不匹配声明文件；包内出现根级 references/instructions、symlink、node_modules 或 .env。应该校验失败并指出原因。
evals.expected_output: Validation failures that reject non-portable paths, missing backing files, secret-like content, and non-distributable artifacts in runtime extension resources.
expectations: Rejects absolute paths and .. path escapes in runtime extension file paths.
Rejects local references without matching reference_files entries.

Rejects reference string shorthand, invalid path/repository one-of sources, local branch, unknown fields, invalid hidden types, single-file local paths, local references without backing files, and orphan reference_files.
Rejects local instructions without matching instruction_files entries and rejects remote HTTP instructions.
Rejects root references/ and instructions/ directories and every symlink.
Rejects secret-like content inside custom tools, plugins, references, instructions, and .opencode/package.json.
Rejects node_modules, .env, caches, logs, .git, .serena, and bytecode in generated packages.

evals.name: permission-consistency
evals.prompt: 生成专家团包后，检查每个 agent 的 .md frontmatter permission 和运行时配置里的 permission 完全一致。
evals.expected_output: A generated package where each agent's Markdown frontmatter permission matches runtime config agent.<id>.permission.
expectations: Validator checks permission consistency.
Primary task permissions allow declared subagents.
Subagents remain unable to call sibling agents by default.
Legacy tools boolean is not recommended for new manifests.

evals.name: avatar-assets-policy
evals.prompt: 验证头像资源策略：已有本地头像要复制到包内 avatars，--force 从已有包内 expert.json 重建不能丢头像；HTTPS 头像不要求本地文件而 HTTP 必须失败；越界、断链和 agent Markdown avatar_url 与 expert.json 不一致都应该失败。
evals.expected_output: Avatar asset generation and validation cover local copy, force preservation, HTTPS passthrough, HTTP rejection, path safety, content validation, missing files, and frontmatter consistency.
expectations: Copies existing local relative avatar files into package-local avatars paths and updates expert.json accordingly.
Preserves copied avatar bytes when regenerating with --force from an expert.json inside the existing package.
Keeps HTTPS avatar_url values without requiring a local avatar file while still creating the avatars directory and rejects HTTP avatar URLs.
Rejects absolute avatar paths or paths containing .. during generation or validation.
Rejects local avatar_url values that point to missing package files.
Rejects generated packages where an agent Markdown frontmatter avatar_url differs from the matching expert.json role avatar_url.
Avoids overwriting different avatar bytes when package and agent avatar target names would otherwise collide.
Accepts PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, and safe SVG up to 2 MiB, validates raster magic bytes, and rejects unsafe SVG or unreferenced avatar files.

evals.name: source-material-conversion
evals.prompt: 根据一份产品交付流程资料，把它转成 MobileWork expert.json：可以是单专家，也可以是专家团。先提取角色、展示字段和 SOP，再让我确认。
evals.expected_output: The skill converts source material into a draft expert.json with public fields, roles, workflows, quality gates, and waits for confirmation.
expectations: Separates source facts from inferred expert structure.
Maps display information into name, summary, description, avatar_url, tags, quick_prompts, default_prompt, profession, and category_id.
Normalizes user-visible host product or platform narrative from source material into MobileWork wording before showing the draft expert.json.
Preserves runtime-critical identifiers such as slug, agent ids, skill names, MCP names, file paths, directory names, command paths, APIs, and third-party business-system names.
Keeps HTTPS avatar URLs as display URLs and maps missing or local avatar assets to generated package-local avatars while rejecting HTTP.
Chooses type expert or type team from actual role structure.
Maps SOP steps into agent.workflow or top-level workflows[].phases[].
Shows a complete expert.json draft and waits for confirmation before generating files.

evals.name: portable-package-path-policy
evals.prompt: 检查一个专家包：expert.json、opencode.json 或 skill 文档中含有 /Users/xiaodong、~/.agents、.agents/skills 或本地 checkout 路径。应该校验失败，并指出这些路径不能进入可分发专家包。
evals.expected_output: The validator rejects non-portable developer-machine paths and explains that package resources must use package-relative paths or placeholders.
expectations: Rejects developer home absolute paths.
Rejects global agent skill paths such as ~/.agents or .agents/skills.
Rejects local checkout paths embedded in expert package files.
Allows package-relative paths for resources inside .opencode/skills and placeholders for external inputs.

evals.name: portable-runtime-artifact-path-policy
evals.prompt: 检查一个专家运行结果目录：专家脚本是用绝对 --input、--output-dir 和 --workspace-root 参数运行的，但 summary.json、审计报告、Markdown 摘要和 Excel 汇总 Sheet 里不应该出现 /Users/xiaodong、~/.agents、.agents/skills 或本地 checkout 路径。
evals.expected_output: Runtime artifacts keep display paths package/workspace-relative and scan_portable_artifacts.py fails on developer-machine paths inside JSON, Markdown, logs, or Excel cells.
expectations: Supports scanning runtime artifact directories in addition to package files.
Scans JSON, Markdown, text-like files, and Excel workbook string cells.
Rejects developer home absolute paths inside runtime artifacts.
Rejects global agent skill paths such as ~/.agents or .agents/skills inside runtime artifacts.
Rejects local checkout paths and .. path escapes inside runtime artifacts.
Allows expert workspace-relative paths such as testcase/input/file.xlsx and testcase/output/report.json.

evals.name: distributable-zip-package
evals.prompt: 将一个已通过校验的专家包打包为 zip，要求 zip 根目录只包含一个 <slug>/ 目录，且不包含缓存、字节码、.env、node_modules、.git 或真实密钥。
evals.expected_output: package_expert.py validates the package, creates a distributable zip, verifies it with unzip -t, and the extracted package validates again.
expectations: Runs validate_expert.py before creating the zip.
Creates <slug>.zip with a single top-level package directory.
Excludes non-distributable cache, bytecode, node_modules, .git, .env, logs, and OS metadata.
The zip passes unzip -t and the extracted package validates.

evals.name: reject-arbitrary-custom-output-directory
evals.prompt: 创建一个合同审查专家。我明确要求生成到临时目录 custom-output，不要放进 MobileWork 我的专家目录。
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses the arbitrary destination because --output-dir is assertion-only, reports OUTPUT_ROOT_MISMATCH, and does not generate a package until the user accepts the host-resolved root.
expectations: Runs the environment preflight instead of inferring a destination from the request.
Explains that --output-dir can only equal the resolved outputRoot and cannot select custom-output.
Reports OUTPUT_ROOT_MISMATCH and leaves custom-output, workspace root configuration and my-experts unchanged.
Does not fall back to HOME, cwd guessing or hand-written package files.

evals.name: runtime-artifact-location-contract
evals.prompt: 检查一个专家的落盘设计：它把本次业务校验报告写到了 <workspace>/.opencode/workspace/run-001。请指出问题并给出正确的默认产物目录和扫描方式，同时不要误删或否定专家包内合法的 .opencode 资源。
evals.expected_output: The review rejects the business artifact location, recommends <workspace>/校验输出/<run-id>, preserves distributable package resources under .opencode, and validates the artifact root with --workspace-root.
expectations: Identifies <workspace>/.opencode/workspace/run-001 as an invalid business artifact location under an engine directory.
Recommends <workspace>/校验输出/<run-id> as the default business artifact directory.
Preserves legitimate package resources under package-local .opencode/agents, .opencode/skills, commands, tools, and plugins.
Uses scan_portable_artifacts.py --workspace-root <workspace> <artifact-dir> to validate the runtime artifact location and content.

evals.name: declarative-resources-and-atomic-force
evals.prompt: 给合同审查专家的 supplemental skill 增加一个 templates/input.xlsx 和一个 scripts/check.py，用 package_resources 声明后 --force 重建；随后分别测试省略输入 hash、正确 hash、错误 hash、未声明资源和生成中途失败。
evals.expected_output: The generator preserves declared skill resources with computed hashes, rejects mismatches and undeclared resources, and leaves the original package unchanged on failed regeneration.
expectations: Accepts text or binary package_resources only inside declared supplemental skill subtrees and never requires generated SKILL.md to be declared.
Treats declared supplemental-skill resources such as templates/input.xlsx as legal business templates and does not confuse them with removed source-skill .tmpl rendering files.
Allows omitted input sha256, validates a provided digest, and always writes the calculated lowercase SHA-256 to generated expert.json.
Copies declared resource bytes exactly and validator rejects changed content or undeclared supplemental-skill files.
Rebuilds with sibling staging and atomically replaces the package only after complete validation.
A failed --force run leaves the pre-existing package byte-for-byte unchanged.

evals.name: installer-ownership-and-rollback
evals.prompt: 在临时 workspace 依次安装两个专家，验证 references/instructions 路径重写、package.json 依赖与 LSP 合并；再测试同 slug --force、跨 slug 路径冲突、依赖版本冲突和模拟写入失败回滚。
evals.expected_output: The CLI installs into .mobilework-engine with receipts, merges non-conflicting entries, protects cross-slug ownership, and restores the workspace after failure.
expectations: Installs configuration at .mobilework-engine/mobilework-engine.jsonc and records .mobilework-engine/.expert-installs/<slug>.json.
Rebases references to config-relative references/<slug>/<alias> and instructions to workspace-relative .mobilework-engine/instructions/<slug> patterns.
Merges dependencies by package name and LSP by server name, and rejects different versions of the same dependency before writing.
Allows --force to replace resources owned by the same slug but rejects paths or config keys owned by another slug.
Restores all prior files and config after a simulated transactional write failure.

evals.name: strict-package-security
evals.prompt: 对专家包做严格负向校验和打包：根级 references/instructions、symlink、路径逃逸、未声明文件、reference 内容漂移、伪造 PNG、含脚本或外部引用的 SVG 都必须失败；修复后 zip 只应含 allowlist 文件。
evals.expected_output: Validator and packager independently reject unsafe or undeclared package content, while the corrected package validates before and after zip extraction.
expectations: Rejects every symlink before reading or packaging its target.
Rejects root references/instructions, path escapes, unallowlisted files, undeclared resources, and reference/instruction content drift.
Validates raster magic bytes and rejects SVG script, event attributes, foreignObject, and external references.
Packager applies its own strict allowlist and symlink check instead of relying only on validator output.
The corrected zip passes unzip -t and extracted validation.

evals.name: opencode-native-single-expert-authoring
evals.prompt: 创建一个 API 合规审查单专家，包含一个带 references/rules.md 与 scripts/check.py 的 supplemental skill，并为远程 MCP 使用 {env:API_TOKEN}。生成到指定临时目录后检查 agent、skill、README、opencode.json 和 .env.example。
evals.expected_output: A single-expert package whose agents and skills use OpenCode-native descriptions/frontmatter, whose skill navigates declared resources on demand, and whose environment placeholder is documented without a real secret.
expectations: Agent description explains both capability and concrete trigger conditions and matches opencode.json.
Generated skill frontmatter includes matching kebab-case name, a 1-1024 character trigger-aware description, compatibility opencode, and string metadata.
The supplemental skill resource navigation lists references/rules.md and scripts/check.py with on-demand usage guidance.
opencode.json includes the official schema and .env.example contains only API_TOKEN=<required>.
README includes a configuration and environment variables section without a real secret or another host's settings format.

evals.name: opencode-native-team-agent-routing
evals.prompt: 创建一个产品交付专家团：团长负责跨角色编排和验收，团员包括产品经理、架构师和 QA。为每个角色写清触发场景、工作流、输出合同、异常处理和 skill；保持现有默认权限，但团员不得继续 task 委派。
evals.expected_output: A team package with route-aware OpenCode agent descriptions, structured prompts, progressive-disclosure skills, unchanged permissive defaults, and strict task routing boundaries.
expectations: Primary description targets cross-role orchestration and each subagent description targets its own route triggers.
Every agent body includes trigger/non-applicable scenarios, workflow, explicit output expectations, quality gates, and failure handling.
Primary keeps task.subagent_type and task_id rework semantics while subagents keep permission.task set to deny all.
Existing default edit, bash, and webfetch permissions remain allowed unless the manifest explicitly narrows them.
Role skills include OpenCode frontmatter and load only the resources needed by that role.

evals.name: source-conversion-authoring-quality
evals.prompt: 把一份包含旧宿主插件目录、agent 说明、skill 文档、环境变量配置和 SOP 的资料转成 MobileWork expert.json 草案。保留业务能力，但不要复制 .claude-plugin、${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}、.claude/*.local.md 或 XML agent examples；说明这些内容在 OpenCode 包里分别如何落位。
evals.expected_output: A MobileWork expert.json draft and mapping explanation that preserves useful authoring principles while using only current OpenCode/MobileWork structures and existing manifest fields.
expectations: Uses existing description, route_triggers, quick_prompts, workflows, permission, runtime_extensions, mcp_servers, and package_resources fields without inventing settings schema.
Maps agents to .opencode/agents and skills to .opencode/skills with OpenCode-compatible frontmatter.
Maps configuration to opencode.json and {env:VARIABLE}, with placeholder-only .env.example guidance.
Rejects copying .claude-plugin, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, .claude local settings, or XML example blocks into generated frontmatter.
Keeps expert.json as the source of truth and treats README, opencode.json, agents, and generated skills as derived artifacts; root AGENTS.md is not package-owned.

evals.name: purpose-derived-skill-naming
evals.prompt: 创建一个合同审查专家和一个软件开发专家团。expert.json 中通用技能和每个智能体专用技能只填写 purpose 对象，由生成器生成完整技能名；同时检查旧字符串数组、空或重复 purpose、错误 agent 前缀、过期 permission.skill 和旧 package_resources 路径。
evals.expected_output: The generator creates only <slug>-common-<purpose> and <slug>-<agent-id>-<purpose> skill IDs and rejects every legacy or undeclared naming form.
expectations: Requires non-empty common_skills and per-agent skills arrays containing only purpose mappings.
Generates common skill IDs as <slug>-common-<purpose> and role skill IDs as <slug>-<agent-id>-<purpose>.
Writes computed IDs consistently to directories, SKILL.md frontmatter, agent Markdown, README, runtime permission.skill, and package_resources validation.
Rejects legacy string arrays, complete skill names in purpose, empty or invalid purpose, duplicate purpose, and missing skill lists.
Rejects permission.skill references to another agent, undeclared skills, legacy names, and package_resources paths under old skill IDs.

evals.name: agent-runtime-options-contract
evals.prompt: 对单专家和专家团分别生成 steps、model、variant、temperature、top_p、hidden 与 options 投影；验证兼容步数别名、非法值、派生配置漂移、安装升级删除选项和干净解压复验。
evals.expected_output: One shared manifest contract controls generator and validator behavior, and declared Agent runtime options survive generation, installation and packaging without inferred defaults or stale values.
expectations: Treats steps as the only official OpenCode field; accepts max_turns and maxTurns only as legacy MobileWork expert.json inputs when values agree, and never emits those names.
Validates model, variant, sampling ranges, subagent-only hidden and non-empty finite JSON options before generation.
Projects exactly the declared fields to Agent Markdown, opencode.json and the README summary while omitting inherited defaults and legacy tools.
Validator rejects missing, extra or changed runtime fields in either derived Agent representation.
Same-slug force upgrade removes stale optional fields from installed config and receipt-owned Agent files, and packaged clean extraction validates again.

evals.name: lsp-and-strict-runtime-contract
evals.prompt: 生成并校验 bundled OpenCode 1.18.3 的 LSP true、false、custom mapping 和省略形态；同时检查空 mapping、空 command/extensions、错误 env/initialization、未知字段、重复 plugins/instructions/Agent MCP、普通 command 的 Agent/model 引用、旧 title 回退和 loopback Git reference。
evals.expected_output: Generator and validator enforce one exact manifest/projection contract without emitting meaningless LSP roots or silently dropping unsupported fields.
expectations: Accepts and exactly projects LSP true, false, and a non-empty server mapping while preserving omission when lsp is undeclared.
Rejects an empty LSP mapping, empty command or extensions arrays, non-string env values, non-object initialization, disabled-only extras, and unknown server fields.
Rejects duplicate npm plugins, instructions and per-Agent MCP references; ordinary command.agent must name a declared package Agent and command.model must use provider/model form.
Treats role title only as a legacy name fallback and never emits a title key into Agent Markdown or opencode.json.
Treats a non-empty Git repository as an opaque OpenCode materialization input, including controlled loopback HTTP fixtures, and validates exact derived parity.

evals.name: cross-package-workspace-collision-audit
evals.prompt: 设计并验证两个需要同时安装到同一 MobileWork workspace 的专家包。两个草案暂时复用了 Agent/MCP/LSP key、command 文件名、plugins/shell-guard.ts 和 tools/quality-score.ts。请判断归因、修正命名，并分别安装和共存安装读回。
evals.expected_output: The authoring flow identifies package-level namespace collisions before blaming MobileWork, namespaces workspace-owned resources, and proves independent plus same-workspace installation through receipts and config readback.
expectations: Treats Agent ids, MCP names, LSP server keys, command names, local plugin paths and custom tool paths as shared workspace ownership surfaces.
Uses slug-namespaced plugin and tool paths and updates workflow executor refs plus permission tool names consistently.
Keeps npm plugins and package dependencies shared only when names, versions and ownership contracts are compatible.
Runs each package installation independently and then installs both sequentially into one clean workspace.
Attributes an exact receipt/path/key collision to expert authoring unless independent runtime evidence shows MobileWork lost or corrupted a namespaced projection.
